description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy Act
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing specific levy rates on commodities. It constitutes a regulatory instrument that establishes compliance requirements for trade and commerce. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa's name and title, the primary purpose is to enact a regulatory measure (imposing levies) rather than focusing on government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments.
